Coven Academy | Premise Featurette | Disney+
"Coven Academy" follows three teenage witches and their charming warlock peers as they face deadly secrets, dangerous power and forbidden love while ancient forces threaten their city. This behind the scenes look with the cast and creative team offers a deeper look into the all-new supernatural series.
